About_&_Key_Points:
About
Incorporated in January 1995, Adroit Industries is a vertically integrated manufacturer and supplier of propeller shafts and torque-transmission components used in driveline systems.
[1]
Key Points
Business Overview
[1]
Adroit Industries manufactures and supplies propeller shafts, also known as drive shafts or cardan shafts, and other torque-transmission components used in driveline systems. The company has more than four decades of operating experience and has developed an integrated manufacturing model covering forging, precision machining, heat treatment, assembly, balancing, and testing.
As of July 31, 2026, it offered more than 5,000 SKUs of torque-transmission components and assemblies.
